The world came frighteningly close to the greatest nuclear disaster in history, but the story of the event isn't that well known. Two hydrogen bombs ~250 times more powerful than the ones dropped on Hiroshima accidently fell on North Carolina. Both weapons hit the ground one of them very well should have gone off but didn't. Why? In this episode we explore the 1961 goldsboro b-52 incident.
